text: ① 07:50 日本央行公布7月货币政策会议审议委员意见摘要； ② A股交易时段 宇树科技在科创板开启申购，发行价格为150.80元/股； ③ 16:30 欧元区8月Sentix投资者信心指数； ④ 可能发布 中国1-7月社会融资规模增量、新增人民币贷款、M2等货币供应； ⑤ 次日03:00 美国克利夫兰联储主席哈马克讲话； 微信小程序搜索“见闻历”，了解更多。
text_en: ① 07:50 BoJ releases summary of opinions from July monetary policy meeting; ② A-share trading hours Unitree Technology opens subscription on STAR Market, issue price 150.80 yuan/share; ③ 16:30 Eurozone August Sentix investor confidence index; ④ Possibly released China Jan-Jul aggregate social financing, new yuan loans, M2 and other money supply; ⑤ Next day 03:00 Cleveland Fed President Hammack speaks; Search 'wallstreetcn' in WeChat mini-program for more.
